en.description: Turn seller-supplied office floor stills into one office floor tour clip per labeled still. This office floor video studio lays out each floor walkthrough clip from the seller-supplied floor photo, then delivers an office listing clip and a floor walkthrough video as separate files. Use it for office floor packs that give each still its own clip.
